decisions.story_title: LG TV Security Vulnerabilities Allow Surveillance in Standby Mode
decisions.reason: Gamers Nexus and Level1Techs found extensive device/network discovery, ACR tracking, and security weaknesses in LG TVs that could enable microphone surveillance even when powered off. Real IoT surveillance risk.

decisions.story_title: Mathspace Data Breach Impacts 1M+ Users in Australia and New Zealand
decisions.reason: Confirmed breach affecting 1,079,819 users. Unauthorized access to internal reporting system exposed names, emails, and other data for students, parents, and teachers.

decisions.story_title: Weverse Data Leak Exposes 422K K-Pop Fan Accounts
decisions.reason: HYBE-affiliated Weverse Company confirmed 422,584 accounts affected. KISA notified on Sep 3. Exposed data includes internal identifiers.

decisions.story_title: Gangnam Unni Data Leak Exposes 220K User Records
decisions.reason: Beauty medical platform Healing Paper disclosed abnormal API access on Sep 4 affecting ~220,000 domestic and international users. Personal information exposed.
